Adrift é um lugar onde pessoas escrevem: Adrift is a place where people write messages and launch them into the sea in small boats. Each boat travels from person to person, around the world: whoever receives it reads the accumulated messages, can write their own and sends the boat on its way.
Você acompanha a rota do seu barco num m: You can follow your boat's route live on a world map: it can dock in up to 195 countries, and each port responds in the language of that country.
Não há curtidas, seguidores nem feed. Só: There are no likes, followers or feed. Just the boat and the path it takes.
Adrift funciona no navegador, no computa: Adrift works in the browser, on the computer and on the cell phone. You can also install it on Android (iOS coming soon) and receive a notification when a boat is approaching you.

Aqui você lança seu barco. Escreva a pri: Here you launch your boat. Write the first message, tap “Launch overboard” and let the ocean do the rest. Every boat is born a Newbie — the world makes it grow.
É onde chegam os barcos lançados por out: This is where boats launched by other people arrive. When one approaches, you make out its silhouette on the horizon — and when it docks, the horn sounds (on any screen in the app). Read the messages it brings, write your own and send it on its way — or simply let it pass, with no guilt. You can also leave a gift on the boat: it sails away richer, and whoever launched it sees their treasure grow.
Acompanhe seus barcos AO VIVO: o ponto 1: Follow your boats LIVE: point 1 is the launch, and each new port appears alone on the map — you can even see the little boat sailing there and the “✍️writing..." when someone is replying at that moment. Zoom in to separate neighboring ports, and read messages from most recent to oldest.
Na tela do Mapa, a aba Ranking mostra os: On the Map screen, the Ranking tab shows the 50 most celebrated boats — from around the world or just from your country. Points come from interactions and, mainly, from gifts received. All anonymous: the boats are the stars, not the people.
O Museu do Porto guarda os barcos que já: The Harbour Museum holds the boats that have ended their journey. Each one becomes a framed painting of what it lived through — countries, nautical miles, messages. Touch a painting and the scroll unrolls with the entire voyage, from the first port to the last.
A sua caixa de recados. Hoje ela guarda: Your message box. Today it holds the thank-yous from people who received a gift you left on a boat. Whoever thanks you stays anonymous, and the thank-you is a ready-made phrase — on Adrift nobody exchanges direct messages with anybody.

Pouquíssimos barcos se tornam Nau Lendár: Very few ships become Legendary Ships. Those who get there become part of the history of the ocean.
Toda viagem termina. Depois que o seu ba: Every voyage ends. Once your boat has known five countries, you can call it home — and it takes real days to return, retracing the path it sailed.
Quando ele atraca em casa, três coisas a: When it docks at home, three things happen: the gifts it gathered pass into your chest, it becomes a painting in the Harbour Museum, and its name enters the Legends tab of the Ranking, forever.
Barco recolhido não volta ao mar. É por: A boat brought home never sails again. That is why the return is a decision, not an accident.
Presente é a única coisa além de palavra: A gift is the only thing besides words that travels in a boat. You leave one on a stranger's boat; it sails on richer, and whoever launched it watches the treasure grow without ever knowing who gave it.
O que você tem para dar fica no Baú. Dar: What you have to give lives in the Chest. Giving costs nothing: an unlocked gift is yours forever, and you can leave it on as many boats as you like.
